rawContent: Congratulations to my friend @meighanstone on her new book AWAKENING! It chronicles the #metoo movement around the globe, and shares the stories of incredible women fighting for human rights and equality. https://t.co/j1sGL8HUr5 #awakeningbook https://t.co/5KKj208Jyv

@meighanstone Thank you, dear sister. 🙏🏾 I’m so excited for the fanfare!! I know the journey and challenge this book represents in your own life. I know God was with you EVERY STEP of the way! I can’t wait to read it! #MeToo #silenceisnotspiritual #awakening
